We are hiring an AI Engineer to build, deploy, and scale AI-driven product features at the intersection of Machine Learning and Applied AI. Join Partex.AI to work on real-world, high-impact AI solutions. " Job Description

We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, deploy, and optimize AI models that power core product features. In this role, you will collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and domain experts to build scalable AI systems that deliver meaningful real-world impact.

Key Responsibilities:
Build and integrate AI/ML models into product features using modern machine learning and agentic AI techniques.
Deploy, optimize, and scale AI systems from prototype to production, ensuring reliability and performance.
Collaborate with domain experts to design AI solutions tailored to real-world business and industry needs.
Work with developers to integrate AI models seamlessly into existing software architectures.
Use data insights to refine AI models, improve product performance, and support feature prioritization.
Required Skill Set:
Strong software engineering foundation with proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX.
Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML models in production using cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
Practical experience with deep learning, reinforcement learning, agentic AI, or multi-agent systems.
Ability to work cross-functionally with developers, product managers, and domain experts with strong communication skills.
Product-focused mindset with experience across the full AI lifecycle from development to deployment, optimization, and scaling.
